display_name: 源模拟信道延迟成分分解诊断
description: 将源模拟 FIR 64 抽头固定分为四个连续窗口，检查其波形分量能量、相干性与重建和；不读取身份标签、F 或目标。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 CPU, two threads, CUDA disabled; PYTHONPATH=/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261109-phase1-source-delay-components-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261109-phase1-cumulant-context-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261108-phase1-joint-particle-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261108-phase1-spectral-quotient-both-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261101-phase1-physical-rich-router-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/pamf_stage2_inference_20261021_r01:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261027-phase1-pamf-repl-shuffled-views-m16-r02-release

data.representation: source received/clean IQ and simulator kernel, widely-linear coefficients, variance
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 frozen source pilot physical IDs, RX4/6 and RX8 by seven views; read indices/rx/scene/split only

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; RX8 is source held group, not independent to DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only privileged simulator oracle, IQ NMSE not identity accuracy or performance upper bound

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura source-only provenance and epoch19 matching source action cache
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA, no F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed original DURA; no target score selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, preserve all GPU and other owner tasks
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source contract mismatch, nonfinite values, failed first-batch fixed-DURA smoke or component-sum mismatch; preserve other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json: 14 source receiver/view cells, four FIR tap-window component energies, pairwise coherence and observed residual

metric_names: component energy relative to summed clean response
absolute normalized real correlation between tap-window components
observed residual relative to summed clean response

rows.method: Four fixed contiguous 16-tap windows of matched source simulator 64-tap action, plus their sum
rows.purpose: Check source structural feasibility of training-only component supervision, without TX or F
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.
rows.budget_ref: 672 fixed source observations, batch16, CPU, no training; first batch real-checkpoint smoke

notes: Four FIR tap windows are fixed mathematical partitions, not verified physical propagation paths.
Source simulator action and source clean are privileged training/diagnostic information, not allowed at target inference; no F/TX/V/target reads or model updates.
The JCAECNN paper uses true identity labels and an additional classifier, so it is not directly reproduced: https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.00648.
Previously explored source pilot; DURA may have seen source records. Energy and coherence do not establish target identity accuracy.
